Q1/23 is a stub for IAA: IAA consolidated from 20-Mar-2023 (11 days). IAA contribution Q1/23: GTV 314.8, revenue 79.9 (service 67.1, inventory 12.8). Adjusted opex reconciliation (adj_opex) taken from each release's "Reconciliation of Operating Expenses" (three-month table; FY tables in Q4/24 and Q4/25 releases). Not published for Q1/23 or FY2023. adj_ebitda.items include the EBITDA build lines (cats D&A/INT/INTINC/TAXEXP) followed by the adjusting items, so net_income + sum(items) = adj_ebitda_published and ebitda_published + sum(adjusting items) = adj_ebitda_published (all periods foot). adj_ni: base_value + sum(items) = adj_ni_published (all foot).

Q2/25 items restated in the Q2/26 release similarly (restructuring 1.1; prepaid -0.2 and remeasurement 0.1 folded; totals unchanged 364.5 / 1.07).

DEFINITIONS / CHANGES (adjusted EBITDA = NI + D&A + interest expense - interest income + income tax expense + adjusting items; adjusted NI available to common = NI available to common excl. adjusting items, less related tax and preferred allocation; diluted adj EPS = adj NI to common / diluted shares, computed on the lower of two-class or if-converted): (1) SBC: "share-based payments expense" has been an add-back in both adj EBITDA and adj NI throughout 2023-2026 (pre-dates 2023); the add-back is smaller than cash-flow SBC (FY2023 45.5 vs 55.8; FY2024 56.3 vs 62.4) because SBC embedded in acquisition-related/integration costs and executive transition costs is captured in those lines. Label changed to "Stock-based compensation expense" in the Q1/26 release (no change in amounts). (2) Amortization of acquired intangible assets: added back in adj NI (and adj operating income) throughout; in adj EBITDA it is inherent in the D&A add-back. Q1/23 16.6 (incl. 7.7 IAA 11 days), Q2/23 76.0. (3) Q1/23: participating Series A preferred -> two-class EPS; "net income available to common" = NI to controlling interests - cumulative preferred dividends - allocated earnings to preferred; new adj items: prepaid consigned vehicle charges (IAA opening-balance-sheet fair-value write-off reversed; negative adjustment, continued in small amounts until Q2/25), gain on remeasurement of previously held VeriTread interest (-1.4), loss on redemption of 2016 Notes (adj NI only), remeasurement of deferred tax on IAA business combination (-1.5, adj NI only). (4) Q2/23: added "purchase accounting adjustments relating to long-lived assets" (step-up depreciation 6.6 + step-up rent 0.9). (5) Q3/23: that PPA long-lived-asset adjustment dropped, retroactively for Q2/23 (adj EBITDA 307.8->306.9; adj EPS 0.85->0.82); "Executive transition costs" added (CEO/CFO departures Aug-2023). (6) Q1/24: adjusted operating income and operating free cash flow discontinued. (7) Q2/25: new items "Loss on deconsolidation and related costs" (SYNETIQ, 19.7) and "Debt refinancing costs" (3.9). (8) Q3/25: "Restructuring costs" shown as a separate adjusting item (previously inside "Other legal, advisory, restructuring and non-income tax expenses", renamed "Other legal, advisory and non-income tax expenses"); NI available to common redefined to also deduct the "adjustment of redeemable non-controlling interest", which is added back in adjusted NI (RNCI item, +5.0 Q3/25); "Accretion of deferred consideration" (J.M. Wood, 0.7) added back in adj NI only. (9) Q4/25: "(Gain) loss on divestiture and deconsolidation, net and related costs" (DDI gain -3.9 net). (10) Q1/26: label changes ("Stock-based compensation expense"; allocation "to Series A Senior Preferred Shares" instead of "participating securities"). The "Other legal, advisory and non-income tax" item can differ between adj NI and adj EBITDA (e.g. Q2/26 3.3 vs 2.8; Q1/26 0.1 vs -0.7) where part sits in interest (non-income-tax interest/accretion).
